title: TagEvent
description: Canonical MQTT payload published by BLE gateways (and sim-publisher). This is the ingest-fn contract — both sim and real hardware MUST conform.

customerId.description: Tenant identifier — injected by gateway firmware or sim

tagId.description: BLE beacon MAC address or UUID

rssi.description: Received signal strength in dBm (always negative)

zoneId.description: Pre-mapped zone identifier (sim assigns from site config; ingest-fn may re-derive)

ts.description: Event timestamp — milliseconds since Unix epoch UTC
